locations.name: Main Gate
locations.full: The Main Gate is the primary entrance to Cabiao Senior High School, where visitors and students begin their campus journey.

locations.name: Principal's Office
locations.full: The Principal's Office handles school administration, policy matters, and official concerns raised by students, parents, and staff.

locations.name: ICT Laboratory
locations.short: Computer laboratory for ICT and programming classes.
locations.full: Computer laboratory used for ICT-related activities, programming classes, practical exercises, and technology-based learning.

locations.name: Library
locations.full: The Library provides books, references, and a quiet study space for research and independent learning.

locations.name: Canteen
locations.full: The Canteen serves meals and snacks to students and staff throughout the school day.

locations.name: Covered Court
locations.short: Venue for sports and school events.
locations.full: The Covered Court hosts physical education classes, intramurals, assemblies, and school-wide events.

locations.name: School Clinic
locations.full: The School Clinic provides basic first aid and health monitoring for students and staff.

locations.name: Guidance Office
locations.full: The Guidance Office supports students with counseling, academic guidance, and personal concerns.

content.heroDesc: Explore Cabiao Senior High School through an interactive campus map and immersive virtual tour. Discover classrooms, offices, facilities, and important locations from anywhere, anytime.
content.about1: Cabiao Senior High School (CSHS) is located in Cabiao, Nueva Ecija, Philippines. This interactive virtual tour and campus map was built so students, parents, and visitors can explore the campus online before ever setting foot on it.
content.about2: Use the campus map to search for any office or classroom, or step directly into the 360° virtual tour to walk the halls yourself. Everything here — from the map pins to the panoramic scenes — is kept up to date by the school's own content team through the admin dashboard.
content.footerTagline: Interactive Virtual Tour and Campus Map — explore CSHS from anywhere, anytime.

spidey.default: Welcome to Cabiao Senior High School! Formerly known as Cabiao National Senior High School, the school was established in 2016 as part of the K–12 Senior High School Program. Located in Brgy. Palasinan, Cabiao, Nueva Ecija, it now offers the Strengthened Senior High School Curriculum through the Academic and Technical-Professional (TechPro) tracks. This Virtual Tour Map provides an interactive way to explore the school’s laboratories, offices, and other key areas.

settings.shortDescription: Explore the laboratories, offices, and facilities of Cabiao Senior High School through an interactive digital campus map.
